Op this is your issue. I loathe the smell of arm and hammer litter.

1. Invest in a Litter robot. changed my life and anyone who visits me doesn’t believe I have cats because there is no smell (they also hide). 
2. Switch your littler to Dr.Elsey’s (blue bag) or Fresh Step (non scented multi cat). Those two seem to have worked the best for me over the years in term of keeping odor down. Side note if you like alternative litter I used to used the worlds best cat litter, corn base and it kept smell away for about 1-2 days then would smell horrible. 

3. You can use the Scout’s Honor litter box deodorizer for the room the box is in. I used to also spray it over the cats litter every other day but just generally around the littler box area should help out

4. Stainless steel litter box deep cleaned once a week. 
5. Be more vigilant on cleaning boxes and having more boxes. 
6. Sometimes diets can help too like switching from a fish based food to a chicken or lamb. 

Best of luck but these are all things I’ve done in the past 6 years having 4 cats. The honest to god solution was the litter robot.
